finalize.title: Finalize recordings
finalize.intro: Choose the recording versions that belong to the set, put them in order, and confirm the timeline mapping of each. Finalizing freezes the set and starts its analysis.
finalize.noVersions: There are no accepted recordings to finalize yet.
finalize.tooMany: A set can hold at most {{max}} recordings.
finalize.readOnlyNote: This season is archived, so recordings cannot be finalized.
finalize.confirmIntro: The set is frozen with these recordings in this order:
finalize.identicalWarning: This selection is identical to the newest finalized set. Finalizing it again starts another analysis.

runs.title: Finalized sets and analysis runs

runs.noRuns: No analysis run has been created for this set yet.

cancelRun.title: Cancel this analysis run?
cancelRun.consequences: Work in progress stops. Results that were already accepted remain. The cancellation cannot be undone.
cancelRun.tooLong: The reason is too long: {{count}} of at most {{max}} characters. Shorten it to cancel the run.

review.intro: Every recording version, timeline mapping, and finalized set of this match. Earlier versions stay unchanged.
review.setsEmpty: No recording set has been finalized yet.
review.loadFailed: The lineage could not be loaded.
